long_biography.plain_text:
Peter zum Felde bought a former vehicle-repair complex at Uenglinger Berg in Stendal and oversaw its return to commercial use. Several shops opened on the previously neglected site, with the furniture retailer Roller joining them as its conversion into a business park approached completion.

At Bad Kleinen, he joined Egon Flemming as a shareholder and fellow managing director to support the Mühlenquartier redevelopment. Converting its old concrete grain silo into apartments required solutions to structural and planning constraints. Their wider scheme combined the reuse of protected mill buildings with new rental housing. Green roofs were planned for the new buildings to preserve the surrounding park's character.
long_biography.html:
Peter zum Felde bought a former vehicle-repair complex at Uenglinger Berg in Stendal and oversaw its return to commercial use. Several shops opened on the previously neglected site, with the furniture retailer Roller joining them as its conversion into a business park approached completion.

At Bad Kleinen, he joined Egon Flemming as a shareholder and fellow managing director to support the Mühlenquartier redevelopment. Converting its old concrete grain silo into apartments required solutions to structural and planning constraints. Their wider scheme combined the reuse of protected mill buildings with new rental housing. Green roofs were planned for the new buildings to preserve the surrounding park's character.
